issues.where: moon just right of the Great Red Spot
issues.what: the shadow is a soft oval stuck to the moon's night limb, with no crisp umbra
issues.fix: offset the umbra from the limb and tighten the penumbra so it reads as a projected ellipse

issues.where: moon just right of the Great Red Spot
issues.what: same soft limb-attached shadow, smaller in this wider frame
issues.fix: use the same tighter projected ellipse as on the closer frame

issues.where: tile A, moon on the cloud deck
issues.what: at native size the shadow still fades as a broad soft oval instead of a defined umbra
issues.fix: sharpen the umbra core and keep only a short penumbra

issues.where: crops K–L, bright upper globe below the limb
issues.what: Several broad cloud lanes stretch into long, smooth ribbons with much less cross-lane detail than the compact red vortex. The bands look dragged across the globe rather than layered.
issues.fix: Break the longest ribbons into uneven, interleaved cloud structures and restore fine detail across the flow, especially as the bands curve toward the limb.

issues.where: crops S–T, near shadowed cloud banks
issues.what: The curled ridges turn into soft, brushlike streaks with little small-scale structure, even beside the brighter cloud tips. The nearest clouds look less resolved than the middle-distance storm rim.
issues.fix: Restore fine, low-contrast wisps and density variation in the near cloud banks without simply lifting the blacks or sharpening the whole frame.

issues.where: crop C, small orange moon in front of the globe
issues.what: The illuminated cap is mottled but soft, and it stops at a nearly straight, abrupt boundary above a featureless dark half. The moon reads like a small pasted-on disk.
issues.fix: Use a curved, terrain-modulated terminator and retain finer surface detail on the lit cap.

issues.what: The brightest strip merges into a creamy band that wipes out the tops of adjacent cloud layers.
issues.fix: Reduce highlight bloom locally and preserve a little separation between the far cloud crests and the atmospheric glow.

issues.where: crops T–U, dense part of the star field
issues.what: Some bright points have swollen or slightly elongated profiles against much finer neighboring stars, giving parts of the field a mottled, blurry look.
issues.fix: Tighten the brightest star cores and reserve wider glow for a few isolated stars.
